notes: Stories defined for manifest snapshot freshness.

stories.title: Manifest Snapshot Metadata Schema
stories.description: Define schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at timestamp, source_hashes, build_id, and freshness TTL contract to determine validity before execution.

stories.title: Snapshot Freshness Validation Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to validate manifest freshness by comparing generated_at against TTL and verifying no source file hash drift since snapshot creation.

stories.title: Auto-Regeneration Trigger on Stale Manifest
stories.description: Implement mechanism to automatically trigger manifest regeneration when freshness validation fails prior to pipeline or Brain execution.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Exposure API
stories.description: Expose internal interface or endpoint to report manifest freshness status (fresh/stale, age, last_generated) for use by Brain runner and DevOps pipelines.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating freshness checks, stale detection, auto-regeneration trigger, and correct behavior within pipeline execution flows.

per_feature.mitigation: Fallback to forced regeneration when validation uncertain.
